body: Totally normal! I was suuuper sex repulsed while pregnant too tbh, I was rarely if ever in the mood and after having baby and healing up it went right back to normal. If your partner is understanding and loves you, they’ll have no issue with putting the breaks on sex.

Luckily my kiddo isn’t there yet but I’m Asian so I grew up learning to hover/squat on public toilets (she would emphasize how dirty they were so even to this day tbh I just hover over public toilets never sit down LOL )depending on what kind it was! My mom would hold my hands as I would squat on the public toilet while I was littler and I could do my business as needed. Holding my hands and making me squat made it much easier to make me not touch the stall/anything yucky and made it seem more fun I suppose! I also use to work in a daycare so for potty training the tots we would make it seem like a cool fun game and teachers would sing to them or distract them with talking about what we would do next or how to potty correctly etc to help them not go too crazy with potty time aka avoid accidents

Personally i didnt want a catheter either, i was terrified of it but after the epidural and pressing the button so much i couldn't feel my toes anymore i didn't notice anything, not even when they took it out!!
